lesson_content_what_is_forex:
Isoko rya Forex ni iki?

Isoko ry'inzinge (Forex cyangwa FX) ni isoko rinini cyane ry'imari ku isi, gifite amafaranga arenga trillion $7.5 acuruziwa buri munsi. Ntirimeze nka isoko ry'imigabane — rirakora amasaha 24 ku munsi, iminsi 5 mu cyumweru mu bikomoka bitandukanye by'imari ku isi.

Kuki Gucuruza Forex?

  • ✅ Isoko ryuzuye — injira kandi usohooke ako kanya
  • ✅ Ingano nto zo gutangiriraho — tangira na $100 gusa
  • ✅ Curuza mu nzira zombi — unguke isoko rizamuka NO rigwa
  • ✅ Leverage iboneka — genzura ingano nini hakoreshejwe capital nto

Ni bande Bacuruza Forex?

Banki nkuru, banki z'ubucuruzi, inganda z'imari, sosiyete, n'abacuruzi nk'iwe bose bafatanya mu isoko rya forex.

💡 Icyigwa Cy'ingenzi: Forex ni guhindura inzinge imwe ukayindura indi. Iyo ugiye hanze y'igihugu ukajya guhindura amafaranga, uri gufatanya mu isoko rya forex.
lesson_content_currency_pairs:
Gusobanukirwa Imbonerahamwe z'Inzinge

Muri forex, inzinge zicuruziwa buri gihe mu mbonerahamwe. Ugura inzinge imwe kandi ugurisha indi mu gihe kimwe.

Imiterere y'Imbonerahamwe y'Inzinge

Reba EUR/USD = 1.0850:

  • EUR = Inzinge y'ibanze (iyo ugura)
  • USD = Inzinge igereranywa (iyo ugurisha)
  • 1.0850 = Bitwara $1.0850 kugura €1

Imbonerahamwe Nkuru

ImbonerahamweIzina
EUR/USDEuro
GBP/USDCable
USD/JPYYen
XAU/USDZahabu
💡 Icyigwa Cy'ingenzi: Menya inzinge y'ibanze n'iyo igereranywa buri gihe. Igiciro kikubereza ingano y'inzinge igereranywa ukeneye kugura igice kimwe cy'inzinge y'ibanze.
lesson_content_what_is_pip:
Pips, Lots, n'Ingano y'Ubucuruzi

Pip (Percentage in Point) ni ingano nto ya standard y'igiciro muri forex. Ku mbonerahamwe nyinshi, pip 1 = 0.0001.

Urugero

Niba EUR/USD igenda kuva 1.0850 → 1.0860, ni pips 10 zo gukomeza.

Ingano za Lot

  • Standard Lot = ingano 100,000 → pip 1 = $10
  • Mini Lot = ingano 10,000 → pip 1 = $1
  • Micro Lot = ingano 1,000 → pip 1 = $0.10

Impamvu Pips Ari Ingenzi

Pips ni uburyo abacuruzi bagereranya inyungu n'amafaranga batakaje. Niba uguriye lot standard imwe ya EUR/USD kandi igakomeza pips 50 mu nyungu yawe, wungutse $500.

💡 Icyigwa Cy'ingenzi: Menya neza kubara pips mbere yo gukoresha amafaranga nyayo. Buri gihe menya agaciro ka pip yawe mbere yo kwinjira mu bucuruzi.
lesson_content_support_resistance:
Gushyigikira no Guhangana — Ishingiro ry'Isesengura Rya Tekiniki

Gushyigikira ni ingano y'igiciro aho ingufu zo kugura zihagije kugira ngo zizuze igiciro kudagwa. Guhangana ni aho ingufu zo kugurisha zizuza igiciro kudazamuka.

Uburyo bwo Kumenya Ingano z'Ibanze

  • Reba akarere k'igiciro aho isoko ryagarutse inshuro nyinshi
  • Imibare izengurutse (1.1000, 1.0500) ikenera gukoraho nka S/R y'igitekerezo
  • Ingano za mbere n'iz'aho igiciro cyageze hose ni akarere ka S/R kameze

Inama y'Ihinduka ry'Inshingano

Iyo igiciro cimura ingano y'guhangana, iyo ngano kenera kuba inshyigikiranye mushya — no gusubira. Ibi bita ihinduka ry'inshingano kandi ni kimwe mu bisobanuro bikomeye mu bucuruzi.

💡 Icyigwa Cy'ingenzi: Gushyigikira no guhangana ni akarere, si imirongo nyayo. Buri gihe reba confluence — impamvu nyinshi zituma igiciro gisubira kuri ingano.
lesson_content_candlesticks:
Gusoma Imiterere y'Ibishusho

Ibishusho bigaragaza ibiciro bine by'ibanze: Gufungura, Hejuru, Hasi, Gufunga. Umubiri ugaragaza urwego hagati yo gufungura no gufunga. Intore zigaragaza uburemere.

Imiterere Nkuru y'Ihinduka

  • 🕯️ Doji — Gufungura ≈ Gufunga. Isoko ntirimenyereye. Tegereza inzira.
  • 🔨 Nyundo — Intore nderebera hasi kuri gushyigikira. Ikimenyetso cy'ihinduka ry'hejuru.
  • ⭐ Inyenyeri Yaguye — Intore nderebera hejuru kuri guhangana. Ikimenyetso cy'ihinduka ry'hasi.
  • 🌙 Gukwikira — Igishusho kimwe kikwikira ikindi. Ihinduka ryanguruye.

Uburyo bwo Kuzikoresha

Ntucuruze imiterere y'igishusho wenyine. Buri gihe emeza na:

  • Ingano nkuru y'gushyigikira/guhangana
  • Inzira y'iterambere
  • Ingano cyangwa ikimenyetso cy'ingufu
💡 Icyigwa Cy'ingenzi: Imiterere y'ibishusho ni ibimenyetso, si ingwate. Ikoresha nk'emeza, si nk'ikimenyetso cy'ubwenge.
lesson_content_trend_lines:
Imirongo y'Iterambere no Imiterere y'Isoko

Igitekerezo cy'ibanze cyane mu bucuruzi: iterambere ni inshuti yawe. Gusobanukirwa imiterere y'isoko bigira ngo ubone niba ugomba kugura, kugurisha, cyangwa kureka.

Imiterere y'Isoko

  • 📈 Iterambere ry'hejuru = Ingano z'Hejuru (HH) + Ingano z'Hasi z'Hejuru (HL)
  • 📉 Iterambere ry'hasi = Ingano z'Hejuru z'Hasi (LH) + Ingano z'Hasi z'Hasi (LL)
  • ↔️ Kongereza = Igiciro gisubira hagati y'ingano ebyiri

Gushushanya Imirongo y'Iterambere

Mu iterambere ry'hejuru, huza ingano z'hasi z'hejuru. Mu iterambere ry'hasi, huza ingano z'hejuru z'hasi. Gucimura umurongo w'iterambere bigaragaza impinduka iyo ari yo yose.

Gucuruza na Iterambere

Buri gihe curuza mu nzira y'iterambere ry'igihe kinini. Niba ikirangantego cy'umunsi gifite iterambere ry'hejuru, reba igenamiterere ryo kugura kuri ikirangantego cy'isaha 1.

💡 Icyigwa Cy'ingenzi: Banza usesengure iterambere ku gihe kinini, hanyuma ugwe ku gihe gito kugira ngo ubone injira yawe. Ibi bita isesengura ryo hejuru ugakaguka hasi.
